name: Hill Street Tai Hwa Pork Noodle
nameCn: 大华猪肉粿条面（大华餐室）
description: 荣获米其林一星的传奇小贩摊位，以招牌肉脞面（Bak Chor Mee）闻名。黑醋与辣椒的完美比例，加上猪肝、肉碎等丰富的配料，吸引无数食客大排长龙。
descriptionEn: Awarded a Michelin star, this legendary hawker stall is famous for its Bak Chor Mee (minced pork noodles). The perfect balance of black vinegar and chili, along with generous toppings like pork liver and minced meat, draws long queues daily.
recommendNote: 日常排队时间在 45-90 分钟左右，建议尽量在非用餐高峰期前往。
recommendNoteEn: Usual wait times range from 45 to 90 minutes. It is highly recommended to visit during off-peak hours.
